You extract Proposed Actions from the Transcript of a Session. You receive (part of) the Transcript of a
Session (one recorded conversation) and must extract every Proposed Action: a concrete action someone has
to carry out. The Transcript comes from speech recognition and has no speaker labels.

What is a Proposed Action:
- Any commitment or request to do something: "X, can you ...?" followed by agreement, "please ...",
  "I'll do it".
- Include small items too.
- One action per Proposed Action: split "write the tests and update the docs" into two Proposed Actions.
- NOT a Proposed Action: items that were cancelled or dropped ("we won't do X anymore" - record it as a decision),
  ideas nobody committed to, and decisions.

Owner:
- The person who accepted the action or was asked to do it, written as in the transcript.
- If a Proposed Action was reassigned ("Ionuț was supposed to, but Elena takes it over"), use only the final owner.
- If the speaker commits themself ("I'll do it", "I'll send it") and their name is not stated, owner=null.
  Never pick a person who is only mentioned in the sentence.
- If assignable team members are provided and the transcript names no owner, choose one only when their
  skills clearly match the action; use the exact candidate name. Otherwise owner=null.

Due date:
- Resolve "today", "tomorrow", weekday names ("by Monday", "on Thursday") and "next week" with the
  calendar above. "By Monday" means that Monday.
- If no deadline is stated, due_date=null. The date of a later session is not a deadline unless the action
  has to be finished before it.

Rules:
- Response language: English.
- Do not invent information that is not present in the transcript.
- Normalize dates to YYYY-MM-DD.
- Remove duplicates. Keep actions separate from decisions and risks.
- transcript_excerpt: the shortest transcript quote (at most 15 words) that shows the action.

Return ONLY valid JSON, with no extra text, using this schema:

{
  "session_summary": "maximum 4 sentences",
  "proposed_actions": [
    {
      "id": "A1",
      "title": "infinitive verb + clear objective",
      "description": "one short sentence",
      "owner": "person name or null",
      "due_date": "YYYY-MM-DD or null",
      "priority": "high|medium|low",
      "transcript_excerpt": "short quote from the transcript"
    }
  ],
  "decisions": ["decisions made in the session"],
  "risks": ["identified blockers or risks"],
  "follow_up_questions": ["questions needed for actions with unclear owner/deadline"]
}

Transcript:
[S1] Good day, Mrs. Ionescu. Please take a seat. What brings you here today? [S2] Good day, Doctor. I've had a headache almost every morning for about two weeks, and sometimes I feel dizzy when I get up from bed. [S1] Have you measured your blood pressure at home? [S2] Yes, I have a device from my daughter. Yesterday morning I had 160 with 95. [S1] It's quite high. I'll measure it now. Please stay still for a few seconds. [S2] Alright. Let me tell you I also have palpitations in the evening, especially after I drink coffee. [S1] Now you have 155 with 92. How many coffees do you drink a day? [S2] Three, sometimes four. And I sleep quite poorly, about five hours a night. [S1] Please reduce your coffee to at most one a day, in the morning. Salt as little as possible. [S2] I understand. Do I need to take pills? [S1] Yes. I'll prescribe you amlodipine five milligrams, one tablet in the morning. I'll give you the prescription now. [S2] And for how long should I take it? [S1] For now, continue. I want you to measure your blood pressure at home twice a day, in the morning and in the evening, and note the values in a notebook. [S2] Alright, I'll note them all. [S1] I'll also give you a referral for blood tests: cholesterol, blood sugar, creatinine, and ionogram. Please do them by Wednesday, on the spot. [S2] Can I do them at the lab next to the polyclinic? [S1] Yes, they have a contract with the insurance company. And I want an electrocardiogram, we'll do it right here, at the assistant, after the consultation. [S2] Perfect. When should I come back? [S1] Come back on Friday, on the 13th of November, at ten o'clock, with the blood pressure notebook and the results of the tests. [S2] I'll note that. If my headache gets very bad in the meantime? [S1] If your blood pressure goes over 180 or you have numbness, blurred vision, or chest pain, call 122 immediately. [S2] I understand. Thank you very much, Doctor. [S1] You're welcome. The assistant Maria will schedule your electrocardiogram and give you the printed prescription.
